workloads.name: parquet_count
workloads.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM lake.orders

workloads.name: parquet_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM lake.orders WHERE order_id < 1000

workloads.name: postgres_rls
workloads.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM pg.customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

workloads.name: federated_group
workloads.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM pg.customers c JOIN lake.orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

workloads.name: federated_selective
workloads.sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM pg.customers c JOIN lake.orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.id < 10 AND o.order_id < 10000 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

workloads.name: parquet_count_coarse
workloads.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM lake.orders_coarse

workloads.name: federated_group_coarse
workloads.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM pg.customers c JOIN lake.orders_coarse o ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

workloads.name: local_high_cardinality
workloads.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS groups, SUM(total) AS total, SUM(n) AS rows FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM local.orders GROUP BY order_id) t
